ai.title: AI Day Seoul Brings Together Korea’s Industry Leaders, Startups and Developer Communities
ai.brief: Over two days at COEX, more than 2,000 attendees converged for AI Day Seoul, bringing together Korea’s industry leaders, startups and developer communities advancing physical AI and AI agents. At the plenary sessions, Deepu Talla, vice president of robotics and edge AI at NVIDIA, said Korea is “punching above its weight,” with Doosan Robotics, Hyundai Motor Group, LG Electronics and SK Group — as well as startups like Real World and Luda Robotics — using NVIDIA platforms to bring general-purpose robotics into the real world. Jonathan Cohen, vice president of applied research at NVIDIA, showed how enterprises can build agents they own and control. Breakout sessions featured speakers from Coupang Intelligent Cloud, Doosan Robotics, LG AI Research, LG Electronics, NAVER Cloud, SK Telecom and Upstage. “It was a genuinely enjoyable time to have candid conversations,” said Hyunho Yang, research engineer for omnimodal foundation models at SK Telecom. ”

sec.title: The Microsoft Outage Left 15 Hotel Guests Poisoned by Chlorine
sec.brief: S. 2 Billion and Disrupts Hacker Infrastructure A hotel in Germany had a maintenance safety system for its sauna area. If the chlorine level got too high, the system emailed the operators. When Microsoft’s cloud services failed, those emails couldn’t go out, the chlorine rose, and 15 guests were poisoned, according to Notebookcheck report . ” states Notebookcheck . ” German emergency services sent 40 first responders. Local media reported that four victims were taken to hospital, and one stayed for further observation. An alarm that depends on email works until the email doesn’t.
